TD13/001EN
Regalia of Wisdom, Angelica
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield -
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4] (This ability is active if you have four or more damage):[Soul-Blast 3] When a ?Genesis? rides this unit, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw two cards, choose your vanguard, and that unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO]( VC) :When this unit attacks a vanguard, [Soul-Charge 1] , and this unit gets [Power] +1000 until end of that battle.
[CONT]( VC/RC) :Lord (If you have a unit without a same clan as this unit, this unit cannot attack)
